infoAlert.generalAccuracy: In our 2024 study, we found that the LLM marks agreed with the marks computer science teachers gave 66% of the time. This means that the marks you receive will not always be accurate.
infoAlert.generalDataPrivacy: Do not include personal data in your answer as we send your answer to OpenAI. We only send your answer, we do not send any personal data with it. You can withdraw your consent at any time in your <accountSettingsLink>account settings</accountSettingsLink>.
infoAlert.generalTitle: Free text questions are marked by a large language model (LLM)
infoAlert.loggedOutDataPrivacy: The only data we send to the LLM is your answer; we do not send any personal data.
infoAlert.loggedOutDescription: We use a large language model (LLM) to mark free-text questions like this one. The model typically returns a predicted mark in under 10 seconds, along with the mark scheme. This gives you a low-stakes way to practise exam-style questions as well as an insight into how LLMs work, and their accuracy.
infoAlert.loggedOutTitle: You must be logged in to answer this question
infoAlert.under13Consequence: You can still read the question, but we will not be able to mark your answer.
infoAlert.under13Description: We use a large language model (LLM) to mark free-text questions like this one. This requires your consent to send your answer to OpenAI for marking. Because you are under 13, we cannot collect your consent for this under the GDPR law.
